gaps.sentence: She spoke with great ___ (WISE) about the risks.
The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: The manager praised the team for its ___ (COMMIT) to quality.
gaps.explanation: The noun from COMMIT is 'commitment' — a dedication to a course of action.

gaps.sentence: The instructions were ___ (WRITE) in six languages.
gaps.explanation: Passive voice: were written — irregular participle of write.

gaps.sentence: The film was a critical and ___ (COMMERCE) success.
The test measures your ___ (STRONG) in each skill.
gaps.explanation: 'Strength' is the noun; 'strengthen' is the verb 'to make stronger'.

gaps.sentence: We've received your ___ (REQUEST) for a refund.
